plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, who says he was taken by an alien, recalls walking through a Barnes & Noble bookstore in a mall in the 1990s. He says he glanced at the wall to his right, saw Whitley Strieber's book Communion, a book about Strieber's own reported encounters with a staring alien face on its cover, and "froze in my tracks." Blitch tells it as his own experience, a jolt of recognition that fits his account of what happened to him.
